title: Natalie Portman's €15.2 million Paris mansion near the Eiffel Tower has a 100-year-old history
summary_full: Natalie Portman purchased a 550-square-metre mansion in Paris for €15.2 million in September 2023. Built in 1912, the four-storey property once served as an embassy before undergoing extensive renovation. Located near the Eiffel Tower, the residence features a garden, gym, library, wine cellar and a glass-roofed reception room. The actress bought the property months before her divorce from Benjamin Millepied was finalised.
